title: The Last Page
summary: On the last night, the footsteps reach the shack and Nora has one plan left.

beats.text: The footsteps stopped outside the shack. A hand slid along the wood.
Twenty shapes between the pines, following Grace's sound.
They cannot swim. So I gave them a lake to walk into.
Grace's tin mug, Ava's whistle, my ranger bell. All noise.
Grace slipped out the back and rang the bell down the shore.
Every head turned. They walked off the sand into the black water.
At the cabin, Pip stood in the doorway. Jonah ran the last ten steps.
"Pip!" Ava cried for him, laughing, and they held on.
beats.speaker: ava

beats.text: "The road is clear. Go. The boats wait."
beats.speaker: tess

beats.text: We piled into the pickup. Grace's hand rested on Ava's shoulder. Glass, not a bite.
Behind us the lake went quiet. Ahead, our headlights found the road home.
